description: This file defines utility functions for parsing route patterns into regular expressions, including handling of route parameters, optional segments, and route key generation for dynamic routes in Next.js.

classes.name: Group
classes.description: Interface representing a route group with position, repeat, and optional flags.

methods.name: escapeRegex
methods.description: Escapes special regex characters in a string to safely include it in a regex pattern.

methods.name: parseParameter
methods.description: Parses a route parameter string to determine if it is optional or repeated, and extracts the key.

methods.name: getRouteRegex
methods.description: Generates a RegExp object and related route information from a normalized route string, handling dynamic segments and route keys.
